system: You are a careful research assistant.
prompt:
Rewrite each sentence below to the target length range, keeping its meaning, its form (one imperative sentence, no digits, no first person, no names) and its level of detail as far as the length allows. Add no justification or hedge.

Return only JSON: {"items": [{"key": str, "text": str}]}

ITEMS:

=== key cd2e50ab1c30
Target: 132-146 characters
Sentence: Pre-filter all transcripts with a language model classifier, spot-check a sample of what it discards by hand, and accept it once its discards consistently look clean.

=== key 25199490adbf
Target: 130-144 characters
Sentence: Keep improving realism while also adding controls that measure how often models detect the evaluation and comparing measured behavior across several realism levels.

=== key 42eeebde31f9
Target: 120-132 characters
Sentence: Pick a few representative misspecified environments, run training with and without the constraint, and check whether the model learns to cheat past the second grader.

=== key b81c03239a1e
Target: 127-141 characters
Sentence: Track evaluation-awareness indicators across model generations, rerun identical evals under multiple realism levels, and compare scores against awareness-free baselines.

=== key ba212ede21ea
Target: 127-141 characters
Sentence: Add an evaluation-awareness probe to each eval run and record the flagged rate alongside scores as a discounting factor when interpreting capability results.

=== key eadc8e1a3f2e
Target: 133-147 characters
Sentence: State that reasoning about training was directly observed in these systems and that gaming is plausible, flagging open causality and generality questions across setups.

=== key 11cbce8d4fe6
Target: 131-145 characters
Sentence: Collect transistor density, die size, memory bandwidth, interconnect, precision formats, and manufacturing node histories across many GPU generations plus successor technology roadmaps.

=== key 985c8998bc36
Target: 131-145 characters
Sentence: Fit the projection on transistor counts, clock rates, and die sizes from recent high-end GPU generations and extrapolate out to the assumed atomic-limit plateau range.

=== key 7ebf650828d2
Target: 159-175 characters
Sentence: Model multiple producer responses to stalled scaling, including more chips per device, architectural specialization, and new materials, and report performance projections under each behavioral scenario.

=== key 53d92e2c52db
Target: 156-172 characters
Sentence: Apply both theory-grounded and intuition-grounded interpretability approaches to the same models and tasks, then compare them against agreed criteria like faithfulness, coverage, and human usefulness.

=== key 17b31eebc9b6
Target: 155-171 characters
Sentence: Require the explanation to account for the identified forms of degeneracy and to predict both training loss and generalization behavior on held-out tests before calling the coverage claim established.

=== key 0aa7223b0854
Target: 146-162 characters
Sentence: Derive a technique that follows the theory's guiding principle but keep each heuristic step explicit, validating it first on toy models where ground-truth modularity is known before scaling up.

=== key f94f8b206d86
Target: 151-167 characters
Sentence: Drop the direction and redirect effort toward interpretability approaches with existing positive results on the models of interest.

=== key d704082e55cc
Target: 136-150 characters
Sentence: Survey active evaluators and potential contributors about which shared resources or documentation they would actually use, then build only the most requested item first.

=== key cb0151a2d90b
Target: 125-139 characters
Sentence: Start with a small scoped evaluations project alongside an experienced practitioner, then reassess fit after completing it before committing to full-time work.

=== key b086ad3de282
Target: 125-139 characters
Sentence: Take on a real evaluation task independently and treat completing it well as the fit test, then pursue full-time roles through the connections that work creates.

=== key 089470f0405d
Target: 133-147 characters
Sentence: Route funding through an established external host that can hold grants and pay contributors directly, with the coordinator setting a written budget before spending begins.

=== key 7fcfc1848860
Target: 138-152 characters
Sentence: Build a paired dataset of matched evaluation and deployment transcripts, test models on discriminating them, and validate the pairs are truly indistinguishable on topic and style first.

=== key 6ff16fd8deaa
Target: 158-174 characters
Sentence: Conclude that frontier models can tell when they are being evaluated at roughly expert-human level, and report the classification accuracy and verbalized reasoning as direct evidence of this capability.

=== key 1c21d4acd36e
Target: 153-169 characters
Sentence: Investigate whether awareness of being evaluated changes model behavior between test and deployment settings, since behavioral consequences matter more for safety than detection accuracy alone.

=== key 5230bbc20917
Target: 151-167 characters
Sentence: Ask the model directly whether it can suffer and whether specific conditions would feel bad, and record consistent or surprising answers as initial evidence worth reporting to the research community.

=== key 1f5f47ea4b01
Target: 149-165 characters
Sentence: Treat any apparent suffering display as ambiguous evidence, and weigh it only alongside controls for input dependence, strategic incentives, and dissociation between internal state and expressed behavior.

=== key 06e99edcabcc
Target: 159-175 characters
Sentence: Measure wall-clock runtime, memory traffic, and FLOP counts separately for forward and backward passes across implementations, reporting each quantity rather than collapsing them into a single ratio.

=== key 8c18af6c6bc7
Target: 159-175 characters
Sentence: Measure actual training runtimes under the automatic differentiation setup in use and report the observed backward-to-forward ratio, treating implementation overhead as part of the real compute cost.

=== key 82f449697e3c
Target: 160-176 characters
Sentence: Extend the work with story-embedded counterfactual probes alone, since the clean format is already characterized and naturalistic stimuli are more likely to surface new phenomena worth studying.
